profile.summary: Bhandari Hosiery Exports Limited operates as a textile and garment manufacturing company in India. The company offers knitted fabrics kora and dyed; and knitted hosiery garments, such as t-shirts, pullovers, sweatshirts, bermudas, polo shirts, track suits, pajamas, lowers, ladies knitted tops with embroidery and prints, etc. It also manufactures, processes, and trades in dyed and non-dyed fabrics.
